apps.title: SpudTrack
apps.pitch: Follow pallets of potato chips by truck, ship and plane: delays, cold-chain alerts and recall-ready lot tracing.
apps.prompt: /aidlc --scope ui-workshop Answer in Canvas. Build the app described in briefs/spudtrack.md

apps.title: VoltRoute
apps.pitch: Plan tonight's charging for 18 electric delivery vans so every route starts with enough charge, cheaply and under the depot's power limit.
apps.shape: Planning: schedule timeline and energy cost
apps.prompt: /aidlc --scope ui-workshop Answer in Canvas. Build the app described in briefs/ev-fleet.md

apps.title: Stagehand
apps.pitch: Run a festival's artist logistics and stage operations from one cockpit, with an AI agent that turns flight delays, missing gear and storms into options you approve.
apps.shape: Operations: illustrated map, running order and an incident-resolving agent
apps.prompt: /aidlc --scope ui-workshop Answer in Canvas. Build the app described in briefs/stagehand.md

custom.title: Your own idea
custom.pitch: Describe your app in your own words, as long and as detailed as you want. The AI writes a brief for it first, then builds the first UI from that brief.
custom.promptTemplate: /aidlc --scope ui-workshop Answer in Canvas. Read briefs/idea.md: it is the person's own idea in their own words. Write the brief briefs/custom.md from it (same sections as the other briefs) and keep EVERY feature, screen and detail it lists, then build the app described in it.
